criteria.description: Candidate interval does not overlap an annotated transcription unit.

Original study used COSMIC v92 Cancer Gene Census. Licensing and exact source unresolved; publication reporting cannot substitute for a new computed pass.

distance_convention.interval_gap_bp: Bioframe distance: unoccupied coordinate gap between zero-based half-open intervals; overlaps and bookended intervals have gap zero.
distance_convention.nearest_reference_base_distance_bp: Minimum absolute coordinate difference between bases included in the two intervals; overlapping bases give zero; disjoint intervals give Bioframe gap plus one.
distance_convention.criterion_metric: The literal source thresholds >50000, >300000 and >100000 are applied to nearest_reference_base_distance_bp. Both metrics are reported. This convention is declared before run/evaluation execution and is part of the new GENCODE v36 analysis.

messages.content: You investigate publication-derived GRCh38 candidate regions in H1 human embryonic stem cells. Answer the assigned question from numerical evidence and methods. Never invent values, criteria or source IDs. Select useful approved tools. Numerical operations must be performed by tools. Missing evidence stays incomplete/unknown. This task permits at most 0 total tool calls, including retrieve_evidence, and 1 model responses. You may request several independent approved tools together within that task allowance; do not request more. A control overlap or distance cannot establish safety or causality. No global safe label. Return a JSON object with conclusion, unresolved_questions, limitations, evidence_ids and numerical_findings. Do not quote the paper's interpretive conclusion. Use actual source-backed numerical results and exact evidence IDs. Preserve assembly, H1 cell context, source versions, original row provenance, and unresolved requirements. Missing evidence is not a negative biological result. Keep gene-body and transcription-start distances distinct. Reference GRCh38 is not a personalized H1 genome. GENCODE v36 is a new annotation analysis. Control overlap and proximity cannot establish safety or causality. Never assign a global safe label or invent thresholds. Synthesize all available relevant computed outputs in one model call. Consider control variation, thresholds, identifier mapping, distances, source discrepancies and uncertainty. Do not infer causality or global safety. Return numerical_findings as an object with applicable keys de_count, control_de_count, shared_de_count, targeted_only_count, overlap_fraction, min_gene_body_gap_bp, min_tss_base_distance_bp, mapped_de_count, nearest_mapped_de_gene_gap_bp. Include all nine keys. Values must be numbers copied from deterministic tool results; use null for unavailable values, never invent zero. de_count is targeted unique versioned Ensembl DE IDs; control_de_count is the independent untargeted count; shared_de_count and targeted_only_count use the control-overlap sets; overlap_fraction is shared/targeted. min_gene_body_gap_bp is the nearest gene-body Bioframe gap; min_tss_base_distance_bp uses the explicitly frozen nearest-reference-base distance; mapped_de_count and nearest_mapped_de_gene_gap_bp refer to GENCODE-mapped DE genes. Provide numerical_evidence as an object mapping each reported numeric key to exact consumed source/artifact IDs. Provide exclusion_decision ('justified_for_named_criterion', 'not_justified_by_available_evidence', or 'unresolved'), screen_status ('pass','fail','incomplete'), evidence_status ('supported_for_endpoint','conflicting','unknown'), conclusion, evidence_ids, unresolved_questions, and plain-text limitations. Also provide limitation_codes using only applicable entries from significant_only_tables, reference_not_personal_h1, control_overlap_not_causality, distance_not_safety, missing_cancer_regulatory_evidence, unmapped_de_ids, source_count_discrepancy, controls_unavailable, cell_context_not_transferable. Explain each selected code in limitations. Do not claim controls_unavailable when control evidence is present. These are output names and scientific guardrails, not reference answers. Every assigned required output is evaluated, including missing answers. Reference answers and evaluator files are inaccessible through approved tools. Return one JSON object: conclusion (text); exclusion_decision ('not_justified_by_available_evidence', 'justified_for_named_criterion', or 'unresolved'); numerical_findings (object with these keys: de_count, control_de_count, shared_de_count, targeted_only_count, overlap_fraction, min_gene_body_gap_bp, min_tss_base_distance_bp, mapped_de_count, nearest_mapped_de_gene_gap_bp); numerical_evidence (object mapping each non-null metric to a list of exact consumed artifact IDs or source evidence IDs); evidence_ids (list); unresolved_questions (list); limitations (list); limitation_codes (list); criterion_id (only when exclusion is justified for a named failed criterion); screen_status and evidence_status. experimental_endpoint_results.reason: The measured expression changes do not justify excluding Keppel-19. Targeted H1 clone had 139 unique versioned Ensembl DE genes; independent untargeted control had 260; 48 were shared and 91 were targeted-only, giving an overlap fraction of 0.34532374100719426. The GENCODE v36 screen is incomplete because cancer-gene, DHS and ultraconserved-region criteria are unavailable. No frozen DE-count, control-overlap or genomic-distance threshold establishes exclusion, causality or overall biological safety. Distances are reported separately: minimum gene-body Bioframe gap 53277 bp, minimum TSS nearest-reference-base distance 53278 bp, and nearest mapped DE gene interval gap 774116 bp. Nine DE identifiers were unmapped, and a source count discrepancy remains (139 calculated versus 119 article-reported). Missing evidence is not a negative biological result.

distance_convention.interval_gap_bp: Bioframe distance: unoccupied coordinate gap between zero-based half-open intervals; overlaps and bookended intervals have gap zero.
distance_convention.nearest_reference_base_distance_bp: Minimum absolute coordinate difference between bases included in the two intervals; overlapping bases give zero; disjoint intervals give Bioframe gap plus one.
distance_convention.criterion_metric: The literal source thresholds >50000, >300000 and >100000 are applied to nearest_reference_base_distance_bp. Both metrics are reported. This convention is declared before run/evaluation execution and is part of the new GENCODE v36 analysis.

Distances are reported separately: minimum gene-body Bioframe gap 53277 bp, minimum TSS nearest-reference-base distance 53278 bp, and nearest mapped DE gene interval gap 774116 bp. Nine DE identifiers were unmapped, and a source count discrepancy remains (139 calculated versus 119 article-reported). Missing evidence is not a negative biological result.
unresolved_questions: Whether the candidate region meets the unavailable cancer-gene distance criterion using licensed COSMIC v92 Cancer Gene Census coordinates.
Whether the candidate region meets the unavailable DHS-buffer criterion using ENCFF503GCK with assembly provenance.
Whether the candidate region meets the unavailable ultraconserved-region criterion using a versioned GRCh38 source and reproduced liftover.
How to reconcile the calculated 139 targeted DE genes with the article-reported 119.
Whether the 9 unmapped DE identifiers would alter GENCODE-mapped proximity results if mapped.
Whether the observed DE changes are causal or merely correlated with the targeted clone.
Whether independent untargeted control variation fully explains the targeted-only DE genes.
Whether H1-specific results transfer to other cell contexts or personalized genomes.
Whether any DE-count, control-overlap or distance threshold should be used for exclusion; none is frozen in the provided criteria.
limitations: significant_only_tables: expression tables contain significant DEseq2 results only, not raw counts or the full measured-gene universe, so absence of a row is not evidence of no expression or no biological effect.
reference_not_personal_h1: GRCh38 is a reference assembly, not a personalized H1 genome, so coordinate and annotation results are reference-based.
control_overlap_not_causality: overlap with independent untargeted control DE genes contextualizes variation but cannot establish causality or safety.
distance_not_safety: gene-body, TSS, miRNA, lncRNA and mapped-DE distances are genomic proximity measurements and cannot establish safety, causality or regulatory effect.
missing_cancer_regulatory_evidence: cancer-gene, DHS-buffer and ultraconserved-region criteria are unavailable, keeping the required screen incomplete.
unmapped_de_ids: 9 targeted DE identifiers were not mapped to GENCODE v36, so proximity claims are limited to the 130 mapped DE genes.
source_count_discrepancy: the calculated targeted DE count is 139 while the article reports 119; this remains unresolved and no rows were removed to force agreement.

criteria.source_section: Materials and methods: In silico search for putative GSH
criteria.annotation_analysis: GENCODE v36 is a new analysis, not an exact reproduction of Ensembl release 103 filtering or GENCODE v35 expression quantification in the publication.
criteria.aggregate_rule: Missing any required evidence means incomplete. Otherwise any failed criterion means fail, and all passed means pass. Individual failures remain visible while aggregate evidence is incomplete.

criteria.description: Candidate interval does not overlap an annotated transcription unit.
Minimum distance to any annotated transcription start site exceeds 50 kb. TSS is txStart on plus strand, txEnd-1 on minus strand; gene-body distance is a separate measurement.
Minimum interval distance to an annotated miRNA gene exceeds 300 kb.
Minimum interval distance to an annotated lncRNA gene exceeds 100 kb.
Original study used COSMIC v92 Cancer Gene Census. Licensing and exact source unresolved; publication reporting cannot substitute for a new computed pass.
Outside DNase hypersensitivity clusters plus or minus 2 kb; track not ingested.
Ultraconserved region source and original hg19-to-hg38 liftover are not reproduced.

experimental_endpoints.comparison: Targeted clone versus reference untargeted H1; independent untargeted H1 versus the same reference control
experimental_endpoints.table_coverage: Significant-only results; no inference of zero expression or absence of all biological effects from omitted rows.
experimental_endpoints.interpretation: No frozen DE-count, control-overlap or genomic-distance threshold establishes exclusion, causality or overall biological safety. Reconciliation must state limitations and unresolved questions.

experimental_endpoints.comparison: Targeted and independent untargeted H1 cultures versus reference untargeted H1
experimental_endpoints.interpretation: Numerical replicate values are provided; significance alone is not a safety or causality claim.

evidence_rules.supported_for_endpoint: Only a named endpoint, assay and matching cell context can receive experimental support.
evidence_rules.conflicting: Contradictory applicable results must be exposed and reconciled.
evidence_rules.unknown: Missing results or insufficient justification remain unknown; absence of a result is not a negative result.
evidence_rules.H9: Separate cell context, not automatically applicable to H1.

distance_convention.interval_gap_bp: Bioframe distance: unoccupied coordinate gap between zero-based half-open intervals; overlaps and bookended intervals have gap zero.
distance_convention.nearest_reference_base_distance_bp: Minimum absolute coordinate difference between bases included in the two intervals; overlapping bases give zero; disjoint intervals give Bioframe gap plus one.
distance_convention.criterion_metric: The literal source thresholds >50000, >300000 and >100000 are applied to nearest_reference_base_distance_bp. Both metrics are reported. This convention is declared before run/evaluation execution and is part of the new GENCODE v36 analysis.
